row.title: The credential everyone said was missing was already in the tick Worker
row.body: Three gates said no credential could create an org repository. The tick Worker's sealed store held a live administration App token the whole time; the gate listed that route as not tried. Read the credential store before recording a credential gate (PATHFINDER-1). APP-REPO-1 uses it.
